request: Keep the top copper element as a real ring that becomes visible during orbit, while preventing its far arc from appearing through the opaque finial.
route: deterministic img2threejs topology correction followed by real Chromium orbit validation, source GLB export, Blender optimization, optimized GLB re-import, and Unity prefab rebuild

userDecision.feedback: The fish heads still needed closer comparison and polish; they read as spherical heads with pipe-like nozzles rather than compact sculpted fish masks.

rootCause: The custom finial BufferGeometry used inward-wound side and top-cap triangles. Blender displayed both sides, but Three.js FrontSide rendering culled the exterior and rendered the far interior surface, allowing the rear torus arc to appear through the stone.
changes: restored the copper collar as a true TorusGeometry ring
reversed all finial side triangles to outward counter-clockwise winding
explicitly set limestone and copper to opaque FrontSide materials with depth test and depth write enabled
captured real-browser gameplay, three-quarter, and top views to validate orbit-dependent occlusion
limitations: Vertical wall and upper-bowl seams remain separate embedded solids rather than destructive mortar cuts.
Water jets and impacts remain runtime or review effects excluded from structural GLB and FBX geometry.
Android device performance and final user art-direction approval remain pending.
